## 1. My Life With the Walter Boys (Season 3)
Netflix is diving back into the dramatic heart of Silver Falls on August 6th with the highly anticipated third season of *My Life With the Walter Boys*. Picking up after a season-ending bombshell, this 10-episode run promises to untangle the complex love triangle between Jackie, Cole, and Alex, all while dealing with the fallout from a family crisis. With the core trio returning and exciting new cast members joining, expect even more emotional turbulence and romantic entanglements.

## 2. Ricky Gervais' New Comedy Series
While the specific title and premise remain under wraps, the return of Ricky Gervais to Netflix in August is cause for celebration. Known for his sharp wit and boundary-pushing humor, Gervais's latest project is guaranteed to spark conversation and deliver his signature comedic style. Fans can expect a show that tackles uncomfortable truths with hilarious, albeit sometimes cringeworthy, honesty.

## 3. A Lush New Historical Drama
August will transport viewers to another era with a brand-new historical drama from Netflix. Though details are scarce, the promise of a "lush" production suggests opulent costumes, sweeping landscapes, and compelling period storytelling. This series is poised to be a visual feast and an immersive escape for anyone who loves to get lost in the past.

## 4. Outer Banks (Season 4)
Prepare for more treasure hunts and coastal intrigue as *Outer Banks* returns for its fourth season. The Pogues are back, and if past seasons are any indication, they'll be facing new mysteries, dangerous rivals, and the ever-present tension of their quest for riches. This season is set to deliver the high-octane adventure and signature camaraderie that fans have come to expect from the beloved Netflix Original.

## 5. Popular Licensed Title 1
Netflix is bolstering its August lineup with a highly sought-after licensed series that has a dedicated fanbase. While the specific title isn't revealed, its inclusion signals a strategic move to capture viewers who have been clamoring for its arrival on the platform. This is the perfect opportunity for newcomers to discover a fan-favorite or for existing fans to revisit a beloved story.

## 6. Popular Licensed Title 2
Joining the ranks of exciting licensed content is another popular series making its debut on Netflix this August. This acquisition likely caters to a specific genre or demographic, broadening the streamer's appeal. Keep an eye out for this one if you're looking for a familiar comfort watch or a series that has already proven its staying power.

## 7. Unannounced Netflix Original Series 1
Beyond the known quantities, Netflix is set to surprise audiences with at least one other unannounced original series premiering in August. This mystery addition is often where the real breakout hits lie, offering a fresh perspective or an innovative take on storytelling. It’s a testament to Netflix’s commitment to delivering a constant stream of new content across all genres.

## 8. Unannounced Netflix Original Series 2
Rounding out the August slate is another surprise Netflix Original, hinting at a diverse range of genres and stories being prioritized. Whether it's a gritty crime thriller, a heartwarming family saga, or a mind-bending sci-fi epic, this unknown quantity promises to be another exciting discovery for binge-watchers.
Bottom Line: August is shaping up to be a massive month for Netflix, balancing beloved returning shows with intriguing new additions and strategic licensed acquisitions.

It’s a busy August ahead at Netflix, with the arrival of a new show from Ricky Gervais, a lush new historical drama, and so much more. Which upcoming series are we most excited about? Let’s take a tour.  So far this summer, Netflix has debuted a few big new series, from historical drama The Little House on the Prairie to comedies like Will Ferrell’s The Hawk . This August, the streamer continues to offer a wide range of genres, including the arrival of popular licensed titles and marking the return of fan-favorite series like Outer Banks and My Life With the Walter Boys . In this article, we walk you through 8 of our most anticipated new arrivals, both Netflix Original and licensed.  Check out here for the full list of what’s coming to Netflix in August 2025.  My Life With the Walter Boys (Season 3) Coming to Netflix: August 6 Distribution : Netflix Original  Just over a year after the love triangle bombshell dropped in My Life With the Walter Boys Season 2, we’re already returning to Silver Falls once more—and this season promises more drama than ever before. The upcoming 10-episode season marks the return of our series leads — Nikki Rodriguez (Jackie), Noah LaLonde (Cole), and Ashby Gentry (Alex) — and also sees the arrival of new series regulars, including Naveen Paddock ( Anything’s Possible ) as Eliot, Chad Rook ( Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City ) as Mac, and Erin Karpluk ( Being Erica ) as Hannah.  “The last time we saw the Walters, Jackie and Cole finally confessed their love for each other, only for Jackie’s boyfriend — and Cole’s brother — Alex to overhear,” the official Season 3 synopsis reads. “But their conversation was interrupted when Walter patriarch George was rushed to the hospital. Season 3 sees the Walters realize what’s important in the fallout from this – and discover that it’s okay to go after what you want. With their love lives still hanging in the balance, Alex turns to his new rodeo riding team, and Cole gets back in the driver’s seat of his life, literally, when a race car driver sees potential in him. Meanwhile, Jackie pours her heart into developing the town’s community space. But when a childhood friend arrives from New York, the life she left behind proves harder to forget than she expected.” Alley Cats Coming to Netflix : August 7 Distribution : Netflix Original  Comedy legend Ricky Gervais knows a thing or two about how to make a witty drama that’s poignant enough to break your heart, while also carrying cynical undertones. Look no further than After-Life , a series that had everyone feeling a rollercoaster of emotions. His next series, Alley Cats , is an animated offering, taking viewers into the world from the perspective of stray cats, ostracised by humans, and left to fend for themselves in the streets.
